content.answer: Use `type(x) is int` (not isinstance) to reject bool, since bool is a subclass of int; or add an explicit check `if isinstance(x, bool): reject` before the int validation.
content.reuse_advice: In any type validator, guard against subclass-of-int leakage by excluding bool explicitly (`if isinstance(value, bool): fail`) before accepting isinstance(value, int), or use exact type checks like `type(value) is int`.
